human_tolerance.notes: Uses treed woodland and forest habitat; suburban records can include escaped pets.

phases.note: Spring and summer timing in southeastern Australia; a single national window simplifies regional variation.

taxonomy.note: GBIF name match returned exact accepted species Pogona barbata (Cuvier, 1829), usage key 2465633; class/order populated from the source's Reptilia/Squamata classification because GBIF's class field returned Squamata and no order.

external.note: Rechecked at GBIF and iNaturalist on 2026-10-31; both return Pogona barbata at accepted/active species rank.

range.note: Assessment reports occurrence along Australia's east coast from northeast Queensland to Eyre Peninsula; national range coded AU. Native status supported by species assessment, while the report notes that some isolated Melbourne records may be pet releases or escapees.

traits.locomotion_modes.note: Ground-dwelling and arboreal, with arboreal activity described mostly as thermoregulation; gallop is a simulation gait judgement.

traits.thermoregulation.note: Ectothermic temperature regulation by posture, position, colour and panting.

traits.nest_type.note: Egg laying is reported; underground nesting is represented as burrow.

traits.perching.note: Arboreal thermoregulation; binary perching flag is a format mapping.

traits.size_class.note: Derived from adult body mass 300-500 g; midpoint 400 g remains below the schema's 1 kg Small threshold.

traits.mass_kg.note: Midpoint of reported adult body-weight range 300-500 g; not presented as a directly measured population mean.

traits.mass_range_kg.note: Adult morphometrics table reports body weight 300-500 g.

traits.length_m.note: Midpoint of adult total-length range 35-55 cm, converted to metres; this is total length, not snout-vent length.

traits.lifespan_y.note: Assessment's species information says average lifespan is approximately 10 years; it does not explicitly distinguish wild from captive animals. It is treated here as an estimate for the wild population under assessment; statistic context remains uncertain.

traits.diet.note: Source says wild diet contains varied plant and animal food but gives no shares; browse/fruit/invertebrate allocations are authored model weights, not a measured composition.

traits.social.note: Solitary is inferred from the guideline's solitary social description; group-size bounds encode that classification.

traits.defense.note: Flees to nearby shelter when disturbed and spreads spines when threatened.

habitat.use.note: Ground and arboreal use represented by authored relative weights; source says both and ties arboreal activity mostly to thermoregulation.

habitat.shelter_tag.note: Burrow used as the model shelter category.

habitat.resources.note: Food categories directly supported as plants and animals; tags and weights are authored simulation mappings. Perches reflect tree use; burrows are supported by the Museums Victoria species account, not included here pending licence verification.

habitat.human_tolerance.note: Avoider and no-garden-use are cautious authored choices; assessment warns isolated Melbourne records may be escapes/releases.

seasonal.strategy.note: ActiveYearRound is a conservative format classification because the consulted source does not describe dormancy/brumation.

seasonal.phases.note: Spring breeding interval generalized to August-December for Australia; this is a hemispheric simulation window, not population-specific proof.

activity.AU.note: Fetched 2026-10-31 from country-wide AU queries; licensed observation counts and monthly bins are retained in query metadata. Occurrence frequency is used as an activity proxy.

behavior.note: Shared ground-forager is used with daytime rest disabled to model diurnality; one food tag selects invertebrates, omitting plant feeding, and climb/bask actions are not represented. Parameters are authored.

look.note: Grey to yellowish-brown upper colour, pale underside, dark markings, prominent beard and lateral spines. Proportions and pose geometry are authored; mesh preview required.

seasonal.life_stages.note: Assessment describes egg laying and references age-related life-history characteristics; stage sequence Egg, Juvenile, Adult is a format-level summary.
